title: /v/ The Musical XII
notes:
Twelfth entry of 4chan's /v/ - Video Games forum user collaboration, /v/ the Musical. Contains popular music & scores covers parodying the video game industry and 4chan's culture.

Digital release. All seven albums were released as mega download links that also includes the DLC bonus disc marked "early access stream edition".

FLAC (1-78, 80-171, 173-205, 207-209, 211, 212, 214, 216, 218, 219, 223-226, 231), WAV (206, 217, 220, 221), MP3-VBR (210, 213, 227-230, 232-234), MP3-320kbps (79), MP3-64kbps (172), M4A-256kbps (215), OGG (222).
